name: GameOn Entertainment Technologies, Inc.
summary: GameOn Entertainment Technologies Inc. operates as a next-generation fantasy sports technology company. It is involved in set-up and licensing, grants, software development, and sponsorship activities. The company was formerly known as V2 Games Inc. and changed its name to GameOn Entertainment Technologies Inc. in January 2021. GameOn Entertainment Technologies Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
